name: Gregory R. Fox
tagline: Top rated Creditor Debtor Rights attorney in Seattle, Washington
about: Gregory R. Fox is a top-rated attorney selected to Super Lawyers for 2017 - 2026. He works at Ballard Spahr LLP, located in Seattle, Washington, and provides legal services for issues involving Creditor Debtor Rights: Business, Bankruptcy: Business, Banking and Real Estate: Business to the surrounding community.
Gregory Fox completed legal studies at Willamette University College of Law and graduated with the class of 2000. Gregory Fox passed the bar in 2000.

Only a few attorneys from each state are selected to Super Lawyers designation for any given year. The multi-factor selection process includes independent research, peer nominations and evaluations, as well as professional achievement in legal practice.
